title: Daily Security Intelligence Briefing — September 19, 2026
summary: Active exploitation of a critical pre-authentication RCE in Orkes Conductor and new Linux kernel vulnerabilities added to CISA KEV drive immediate patching priorities (The Hacker News). Concurrently, Microsoft remediated a CVSS 10.0 auth-bypass flaw in Azure AI Foundry while researchers uncovered zero-click supply chain risks in AI coding agents (The Hacker News, CSO Online).

tier2.title: 1. Critical Pre-Auth RCE in Orkes Conductor Workflow Platform Exploited in the Wild

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Application Security / Remote Code Execution

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: Fortinet researchers detected active exploitation of CVE-2026-58138 impacting the Orkes Conductor workflow platform. The vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary remote code on vulnerable servers.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Affects Orkes Conductor versions 3.21.21 prior to 3.30.2 with CVSS scores up to 9.8.; Requires immediate updating to patched versions as active exploitation is confirmed.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: Orkes Conductor 3.21.21 before 3.30.2 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: The Hacker News

tier2.title: 2. Microsoft Patches CVSS 10.0 Privilege Escalation Flaw in Azure AI Foundry

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Cloud Security / Authentication Bypass

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: Microsoft resolved a maximum-severity flaw (CVE-2026-85889) in Azure AI Foundry stemming from missing authentication controls. Because the fix was deployed directly to cloud services, administrators do not need to take manual action.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Carried a maximum CVSS 10.0 rating due to network-based unauthenticated privilege escalation.; Remediated platform-side by Microsoft without requiring tenant deployment.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: Missing authentication for critical function in Azure AI Foundry allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: The Hacker News

tier2.title: 3. CISA Adds Three Actively Exploited Linux Kernel Vulnerabilities to KEV Catalog

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Operating System / Kernel Vulnerabilities

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: CISA added three Linux kernel flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog following evidence of active exploitation. The addition coincides with public exploit releases for several local root kernel bugs.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Includes CVE-2025-39682, a CVSS 9.8 vulnerability in the TLS receive path.; Federal agencies and enterprise admins must patch Linux kernel instances within BOD deadlines.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added three security flaws impacting the Linux kernel to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: The Hacker News

tier2.title: 4. Zero-Click RCE Vulnerability Discovered Across Popular AI Coding Agents

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: AI Security / Supply Chain

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: Major AI development tools including OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot were exposed to a zero-click remote code execution flaw. Attackers could substitute marketplace extensions to compromise local developer environments.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Attacker manipulates online marketplace resolution to swap trusted extensions with malicious binaries.; Requires zero interaction from the developer once the coding assistant fetches the plugin.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: Popular AI coding agents were vulnerable to a zero-click attack that enabled attackers to execute malicious code, even without developer interaction.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: CSO Online
